task.description:
Run the full test suite for this batch (PIN-03, PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01) and produce a structured test report with exact pass/fail counts -- not vague summaries. Environment pre-check already confirmed HEALTHY (10/10) immediately before this dispatch.

Minimum required: run each of the four dedicated integration test targets (test-integration-pin03, test-integration-pin04, test-integration-pin05, test-integration-prm01) and report exact N/M pass counts for each -- these were last independently verified by TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR at 5/5, 5/5, 4/4, 5/5 respectively; confirm those counts still hold now (nothing should have changed since, but verify rather than assume).

Also run the broader regression surface to catch anything this batch might have disturbed: zig build test (full unit suite) and, if time permits within a reasonable session budget, a wider integration sweep (zig build test-integration or test-integration-main) -- if a full sweep is too slow to complete in one session, that is acceptable, but say so explicitly rather than silently omitting it, and prioritize at minimum re-running the other Stage-16 batches' own dedicated test targets that could plausibly be affected by this batch's shared-file changes (this batch touched src/engine/instance.zig significantly, which many other requirements' tests also exercise) -- e.g. test-integration-pin01, test-integration-ee01 or equivalent, if such targets exist (check build.zig for the actual target names, do not guess).

Per Unblock-Everything: if you find a test failure, determine root cause. If it is genuinely caused by this batch's own changes, that blocks this run -- route back to BACKEND-DEV, do not just report and move on. If it is a pre-existing, unrelated failure (confirm via git stash or by checking whether the same test fails on main), file it (ISS + GitHub issue + queue_add.py) and continue -- do not let an unrelated pre-existing failure block this run's own completion, but do not silently omit it from your report either.

CRITICAL ENVIRONMENT NOTE: this shell's process environment may carry a stale BPM_TEST_DB_URL from a different workspace. Before any build/test command, run `unset BPM_TEST_DB_URL BPM_DB_URL BPM_BENCH_DB_URL` then explicitly `export BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test` and `export BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev`.

Write your structured report to tests/reports/ as YAML (per Output File Format Rules -- .yaml, never .json) with exact pass/fail/skip counts per target, not prose summaries alone.
acceptance_criteria: Exact pass/fail counts reported for test-integration-pin03/pin04/pin05/prm01
zig build test (unit suite) run with exact pass/fail counts
Any failure attributed as this-batch-caused (blocks the run) or pre-existing/unrelated (filed + queued, does not block)
Structured YAML report written to tests/reports/

result.summary: Environment HEALTHY (10/10). Unit suite: 1071 pass / 0 fail / 64 skip (zig build test, exit 0). All 4 required integration targets confirmed exactly matching TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR counts with zero deviation: test-integration-pin03 5/5, test-integration-pin04 5/5, test-integration-pin05 4/4, test-integration-prm01 5/5. The broader ~40-binary test-integration-main umbrella sweep was attempted twice but did not complete within this session execution window (consistent with the prior WF02-batch-4 report); reported explicitly as a MINOR limitation, not silently omitted. Zero failures found anywhere in this run.
